partialDate.description: ISO 8601 date with optional precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

description: Common record for a person persecuted by National Socialism (victim of the Shoah or other persecuted groups), merged from one or more sources. Every record must carry provenance and licence in sources[]; field_sources says which source provided each top-level value.

alternate_ids.description: Other ids under which the same person was known (merged records, previous ids).

fate.description: Best-supported fate. Derived conservatively; 'unknown' when no evidence.

fate_basis.description: How fate was derived: inscription_keywords, wikidata_manner_of_death, wikidata_place_of_death, source_field.

field_sources.description: For every top-level scalar field that has a value (except fate_basis/subject_type): the source_ids that provided that exact value.

id.description: Stable id with a source prefix: wd-<Qid> when the person has a Wikidata item, otherwise <source prefix>-<record id> (e.g. st-n10010972992).

license.description: Licence of the linked content when it is known and relevant (e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0 for Wikipedia text).

text_url.description: Site-relative URL of a licensed text extract kept elsewhere in this site.

type.description: e.g. gedenkbuch, yad_vashem, ushmm, arolsen, local_biography, described_at, website, wikipedia, wikipedia_list_entry, wikidata, openstreetmap

image.description: Wikimedia Commons file page or image URL (linked, not copied).

memorial_id.description: Id of the memorial object (OSM n/w id or Wikidata Qid).

name.description: Full display name as given by the source (null when the memorial is anonymous).

restrictions.description: Políticas aplicadas al publicar (p. ej. survivor_minimization: sin enlaces a fichas de registro).

license.description: SPDX-like licence id, e.g. ODbL-1.0, CC0-1.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0

subject_type.description: collective = memorial for a group (e.g. a Stolperschwelle) rather than one person. Omitted when 'person' (default).

variants.description: Values that disagree with the chosen one, kept with their source (never silently discarded).

title: Kauffmann List person record
